bullets_zh: 由API Evangelist整理的BrainCo公开API接口第三方GitHub档案。
BrainCo被描述为由哈佛创新实验室创立的神经技术公司，开发非侵入式BCI硬件和开发者SDK。
有助于梳理消费/科研EEG设备API，且无需抓取实时价格。
bullets_en: Independent third-party GitHub profile of BrainCo's public API surface by API Evangelist.
BrainCo is described as a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDKs.
Useful for mapping consumer/research EEG device APIs without scraping live prices.
items.brief: 第三方整理的BrainCo公开API档案，便于了解非侵入式BCI开发者接口。
items.brief_en: Third-party GitHub profile of BrainCo's public API surface, useful for non-invasive BCI developer integration.
items.raw_excerpt: BrainCo — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCal

The board is an 8-channel wet-gel EEG platform for research use.
